verdict.rationale: Wise Business exposes an extensive, well-documented public API covering accounts, payments, cards, webhooks, disputes, statements and more, with a comprehensive API reference site and llms.txt discoverable entry point — clearly enabling programmatic/agentic control. Missing for 10: a publicly served machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed OpenAPI endpoints returned 404) and independent third-party developer corroboration of the API's reliability/completeness beyond vendor docs.
